Constraints not expressible in ER:
• (stadium_name, city) must be UNIQUE
• (competition name, season) must be UNIQUE
• attendance ≤ stadium capacity
• No two matches within 120 min at same stadium
• No club in two matches within 120 min
• No referee in two matches within 120 min
• Max 11 starters per club per match
• Max 23 squad players per club per match
• Red/yellow card suspension rules 
-> Each person has exactly one nationality. Dual citizenship is not allowed. 
->The specialization of Person into Player, Manager, and Referee is disjoint and total.
->  Numeric constraints such as market_value > 0, height_cm > 0, and years_experience ≥ 0 must be hold.
->  player cannot be on loan without first having a parent club.
-> A referee may not be assigned to two matches whose start times are within 120 minutes of each other.
->The foundation year of a club must be a valid past year. 
-> A player may not have two active contracts of the same type at the same time.
-> A loan contract is valid only if the player holds an active permanent contract with a different club.
-> A player may be associated with at most two clubs simultaneously (one permanent and one loan).
-> Each club maintains a squad: the set of players currently under contract
-> The end date of a contract must be strictly later than its start date.
-> A player cannot be on loan without a parent club. and parent club != loan club.
-> The from club id and to club id must refer to different clubs.

-> Transfer constraints: from_club_id != to_club_id; Free transfer fee=0; Purchase/Loan fee>0; Loan transfer requires an active Permanent contract with parent club (and parent club must match from_club_id).
